title: Skill Edit Step Ordering Ref (T3)
desc: Dated incident history + original workaround-era notes for skill-edit-step-ordering-spec, migrated out to fix a FAT-skill score drop 2026-07-14.
steps: ORIGINAL PROBLEM (pre-implementation, now historical): --add-step always appended to end, no insert-before/after flag, --step N --content intermittently dispatched as background task instead of synchronous -- misplaced steps required ugly ordering hacks.

WORKAROUND ERA (pre-implementation): append then manually reorder step 1 text, retry --step N --content once on background failure, label misplaced steps with a parenthetical, note-and-skip for delete. Superseded once --insert-before/after/--move-step/--delete-step/--swap-steps/--reorder actually shipped.
SUGGEST REF: ts=2026-05-23T06:18:21 DG-wkappbot-sdk tracked implementation status of the MUST/NICE spec items.

BLIND SEQUENTIAL --delete-step IS RENUMBER-UNPREDICTABLE (2026-06-28 incident): deleting a fixed step number N repeatedly does not reliably walk the intended step -- renumber plus auto step-ref-update shifts positions unpredictably, can delete a KEEPER. SAFE PROCEDURE: delete from highest step number down to lowest, or verify-read between deletes and target only the confirmed current number, always check the delete output echoed text and abort if it shows a keeper, re-add via --add-step if a keeper was wrongly deleted.

RE-CONFIRMED 2026-07-03 (agent-failure-reflection-gate slimming): same failure mode recurred -- step numbering drifted between read and delete, likely a concurrent background sync. Confirms the safe procedure is still necessary, not a one-off.
